<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#140A1F">
<title>CD Unión Popular de Palencia — Fútbol popular castellano</title>
<meta name="description" content="Web oficial del CD Unión Popular de Palencia. Club de fútbol popular fundado en 2018, propiedad de sus socios. Calendario, plantilla, histórico, tienda y campaña de socios. Fútbol con carácter castellano en el Sergio Asenjo.">
<meta name="robots" content="index, follow">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://www.unionpopularpalencia.com/">
<!-- Open Graph (WhatsApp, Facebook, etc.) -->
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="CD Unión Popular de Palencia">
<meta property="og:title" content="CD Unión Popular de Palencia — Fútbol popular castellano">
<meta property="og:description" content="Club de fútbol popular de Palencia, propiedad de sus socios desde 2018. Calendario, tienda, histórico y campaña de socios 26/27.">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://www.unionpopularpalencia.com/">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://www.unionpopularpalencia.com/escudo-og.png">
<meta property="og:image:alt" content="Escudo del CD Unión Popular de Palencia">
<meta property="og:locale" content="es_ES">
<!-- Twitter / X -->
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary">
<meta name="twitter:site" content="@UPPalencia">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="CD Unión Popular de Palencia">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Fútbol popular con carácter castellano. Club propiedad de sus socios desde 2018.">
<meta name="twitter:image" content="https://www.unionpopularpalencia.com/escudo-og.png">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Oswald:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --fondo:#140A1F;
  --fondo-2:#1A0E26;
  --superficie:#241534;
  --superficie-2:#2E1B42;
  --morado:#7B2FBE;
  --morado-osc:#4A1772;
  --lila:#B98CE8;
  --trigo:#E8C97A;
  --trigo-osc:#B8912E;            /* acento castellano: espiga */
  --texto:#FFFFFF;
  --texto-2:#CFC6D8;
  --borde:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --nav-h:72px;
  --util-h:34px;
  --display:'Anton', Impact, sans-serif;
  --condensada:'Oswald', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
  --cuerpo:'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--fondo);color:var(--texto);font-family:var(--cuerpo);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
.hero,.club,.socio-banner{max-width:100vw}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.05}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
@media (min-width:1400px){ .wrap{max-width:1240px} }
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.22em;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--lila)}
.section{padding:72px 0}
@media (min-width:1200px){ .section{padding:84px 0} }
@media (min-width:1200px){
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(4.2rem,5.6vw,6rem)}
  .hero p{font-size:1.14rem;max-width:56ch}
  .hero .dorsal{opacity:.9}
  .cd-box .num{font-size:2.6rem}
  .vid-card{flex-basis:300px}
  .embed-marco,.embed-marco iframe{height:560px}
  .jug-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(224px,1fr));gap:22px}
}
@media (min-width:761px){
  table.clasif tbody tr{transition:background .2s}
  table.clasif tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(232,201,122,.06)}
  table.clasif tbody tr:nth-child(even):not(:hover){background:rgba(255,255,255,.015)}
  footer{border-top:1px solid transparent;border-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--trigo),transparent) 1}
}
.section-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:34px}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem)}
.section-head a{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lila);white-space:nowrap}
.section-head a:hover{color:var(--trigo)}
.btn{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.9rem;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:6px;transition:transform .25s,background .25s,color .25s;cursor:pointer;border:none}
.btn-primario{background:var(--morado);color:#fff}
.btn-primario:hover{background:#8F3FD6;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-borde{border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);color:#fff;background:transparent}
.btn-borde:hover{border-color:var(--trigo);color:var(--trigo);transform:translateY(-2px)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--trigo);outline-offset:2px}
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;background:var(--trigo);color:#231404;font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:12px 22px;z-index:2000;border-radius:0 0 8px 0}
.skip-link:focus{left:0}

/* ============ BARRA UTILITARIA ============ */
.utility{background:#0E0716;border-bottom:1px solid var(--borde);font-size:.78rem}
.utility .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;height:34px}
.utility .redes{display:flex;gap:14px;color:var(--texto-2)}
.utility .redes a:hover{color:var(--trigo)}
.utility .socio{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--trigo)}

/* ============ NAV ============ */
header.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1000;background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid var(--borde);isolation:isolate}
header.nav::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:rgba(20,10,31,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:var(--nav-h)}
.marca{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.marca .nombre{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.15}
.marca .nombre small{display:block;font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--lila);font-weight:500}
nav.menu{display:flex;gap:28px}
nav.menu a{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--texto-2);position:relative;padding:6px 0}
nav.menu a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--trigo);transition:width .25s}
nav.menu a:hover{color:#fff}
nav.menu a:hover::after{width:100%}
nav.menu a.act{color:#fff}
nav.menu a.act::after{width:100%}
.hamb{display:none;background:none;border:none;color:#fff;font-size:1.6rem;cursor:pointer}
@media (min-width:761px){
  .section-head h2{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding-bottom:10px}
  .section-head h2::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:56px;height:3px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--trigo),transparent);border-radius:2px}
}

.vista-btn{background:rgba(232,201,122,.07);border:1px solid var(--borde);color:var(--texto-2);cursor:pointer;border-radius:999px;
  font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;margin-right:14px;transition:all .25s;white-space:nowrap}
.vista-btn:hover{color:var(--trigo);border-color:var(--trigo)}

/* Vista móvil forzada en pantallas anchas: columna de teléfono centrada */
@media (min-width:761px){
  html.vista-movil body{max-width:432px;margin:0 auto;border-inline:1px solid var(--borde);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 10px #0D0714,0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
    box-shadow:0 0 90px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
  html.vista-movil .wrap{padding:0 16px}
  html.vista-movil nav.menu{display:none}
  html.vista-movil .hamb{display:block}
  html.vista-movil .cal-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  html.vista-movil .liga-lista{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  html.vista-movil .club-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}
  html.vista-movil .clubes-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  html.vista-movil .hero{min-height:auto;padding:54px 0 40px}
  html.vista-movil .hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,10vw,3.2rem)}
  html.vista-movil .hero .dorsal{font-size:15rem;right:-8%}
  html.vista-movil .section{padding:48px 0}
  html.vista-movil .match-card{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  html.vista-movil .match-card .vs{grid-column:1/-1;order:3}
  html.vista-movil .match-card .countdown{order:4}
  html.vista-movil .cd-box .num{font-size:1.8rem}
  html.vista-movil .section-head h2::after{display:none}
}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:86vh;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 20%, rgba(123,47,190,.35), transparent 55%),
    linear-gradient(160deg,#2E1B42 0%, #140A1F 60%),
    var(--fondo);
}
.hero::before{ /* rayas de campo */
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(255,255,255,.022) 0 90px, transparent 90px 180px);
}
.hero .dorsal{position:absolute;right:-2%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-52%);font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(18rem,42vw,34rem);color:rgba(255,255,255,.05);line-height:1;user-select:none;pointer-events:none}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;padding-top:60px;padding-bottom:60px}
.hero .eyebrow{color:var(--trigo)}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7.2vw,5.4rem);margin:14px 0 18px;max-width:14ch}
.hero h1 .morado{color:var(--lila)}
.hero p{color:var(--texto-2);max-width:52ch;margin-bottom:30px;font-size:1.05rem}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hero .fund{position:absolute;left:24px;bottom:104px;z-index:6;font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--texto-2);text-transform:uppercase}

/* ============ PRÓXIMO PARTIDO ============ */
.match-band{margin-top:-70px;position:relative;z-index:5;padding-bottom:8px}
.match-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 34px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:26px;align-items:center;
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.match-meta{text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1;font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--lila)}
.equipo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center}
.equipo .n{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.vs{text-align:center}
.vs .fecha{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
.vs .campo{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.countdown{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:18px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.cd-box{text-align:center;min-width:70px}
.cd-box .num{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.4rem;color:var(--trigo);line-height:1}
.cd-box .lab{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.25em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:6px}

/* ============ ESCUDOS SVG ============ */
.crest{width:96px;height:96px;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}
.crest.sm{width:40px;height:40px}
.crest.xs{width:26px;height:26px}


/* ============ CALENDARIO / PLANNING ============ */
.leyenda{display:flex;gap:18px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2);align-items:center}
.leyenda span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.leyenda .pt{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
.leyenda .pt.ent{background:var(--lila)}
.leyenda .pt.par{background:var(--trigo)}
.cal-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.calendario{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#1E1029,#120818);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:18px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.cal-dow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.cal-dow span{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--lila);text-align:center;padding-bottom:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(185,140,232,.35)}
.cal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:8px}
.dia{background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:9px;min-height:82px;padding:7px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;position:relative}
.dia.vacio{background:transparent;border-color:transparent}
.dia .n{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.dia.finde .n{color:var(--lila)}
.dia .ev{font-size:.62rem;line-height:1.25;font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--texto-2);display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:flex-start}
.dia .ev b{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.dia.entreno{border-color:rgba(185,140,232,.35)}
.dia.partido{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(123,47,190,.4),rgba(74,23,114,.25));border-color:var(--trigo);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(232,201,122,.25) inset}
.dia.partido .n{color:var(--trigo)}
.dia.hoy::after{content:"HOY";position:absolute;top:6px;right:7px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--trigo);background:rgba(232,201,122,.15);border:1px solid rgba(232,201,122,.5);border-radius:3px;padding:1px 4px}
.agenda{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:18px;padding:24px}
.agenda h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--trigo);margin-bottom:16px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.agenda ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:14px}
.agenda li{border-left:3px solid var(--morado);padding-left:12px}
.agenda .d{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--trigo)}
.agenda .r{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.9rem;color:#fff;text-transform:uppercase}
.agenda .c{font-size:.76rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.agenda-nota{margin-top:18px;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--texto-2);border-top:1px solid var(--borde);padding-top:12px}
.agenda li.memorial{border-left-color:var(--trigo);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(232,201,122,.10),transparent 70%);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:10px 10px 10px 12px}
.agenda .mem-titulo{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--trigo);margin-bottom:4px}
.dia.memorial{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--trigo)}
.crest-rival{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.28);font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.8rem;color:var(--texto-2)}




/* ============ ESCUDOS RIVALES ============ */
.crest-img{object-fit:contain;background:transparent}
.crest-fallback{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:2px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.3);font-family:var(--display);font-size:.42em;color:var(--texto-2);letter-spacing:.05em}
.crest.xs{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:2.2rem}
td .crest.xs{vertical-align:middle;margin-right:9px}
.equipo-celda{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.agenda .r .crest.xs{margin-right:6px}

/* ============ NOTICIAS ============ */
.news-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:24px}
.news-card{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.news-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.news-img{height:190px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.news-img .ph{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--display);font-size:3.4rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.16);transition:transform .45s}
.news-card:hover .news-img .ph{transform:scale(1.07)}
.ph-1{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4A1772,#7B2FBE)}
.ph-2{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2E1B42,#4A1772)}
.ph-3{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3A2153,#8F3FD6)}
.tag{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;background:var(--morado);font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:4px}
.tag.trigo{background:var(--trigo);color:#231404}
.news-body{padding:20px 22px 24px}
.news-body time{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--texto-2);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.news-body h3{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:1.15rem;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;margin:8px 0 10px;line-height:1.35}
.news-body p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--texto-2)}


/* ============ NOTICIAS / REDES ============ */
.auto-nota{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tab{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);color:var(--texto-2);font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.82rem;padding:11px 22px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s}
.tab:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--lila)}
.tab.activa{background:var(--morado);border-color:var(--trigo);color:#fff}
.panel-red{display:none}
.panel-red.activa{display:block}
.consent,.x-card{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--superficie-2),var(--superficie));border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:16px;padding:44px 32px;text-align:center;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}
.consent-ic{font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--lila);margin-bottom:10px}
.consent h3,.x-card h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.5rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.consent p,.x-card p{color:var(--texto-2);font-size:.9rem;max-width:44ch;margin:0 auto 22px}
.consent .mini{display:block;margin-top:14px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--lila)}
.consent .mini:hover{color:var(--trigo)}
.ig-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:18px}
.ig-post{position:relative;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--borde);background:var(--superficie);aspect-ratio:1;display:block}
.ig-post img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .45s}
.ig-post:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.ig-post .cap{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(10,4,16,.94));padding:34px 14px 14px;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.35;color:#fff;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.ig-post:hover .cap{opacity:1}
.ig-post .tipo{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);border-radius:5px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:.7rem}
.ig-cta{text-align:center;margin-top:26px}
.aviso-config{background:rgba(232,201,122,.08);border:1px solid rgba(232,201,122,.35);border-radius:12px;padding:20px 22px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--texto-2);max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;text-align:left}
.aviso-config b{color:var(--trigo)}
.aviso-config code{background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--lila)}



/* ============ LOGOS DE REDES ============ */
.ic-red{display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-position:center;vertical-align:-3px;flex-shrink:0}
.ic-red.mini{width:13px;height:13px;vertical-align:-2px}
.ic-red.grande{width:22px;height:22px;vertical-align:-5px}
.ic-red.enorme{width:52px;height:52px;opacity:.5}
.red-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.ic-yt{font-size:.9em;color:#FF3D3D;font-style:normal}
.logos-consent{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
.utility .redes a{transition:opacity .25s}
.utility .redes a:hover{opacity:.75;color:var(--trigo)}
.fuentes a{padding:0}
.foot-grid .red-link{gap:8px}
.red-badge .ic-red{filter:none}


.crest.cal{width:22px;height:22px;font-size:1.6rem;flex-shrink:0}
.dia .ev-partido{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;width:100%}
.dia .ev-partido b{font-size:.62rem}
.dia.partido{justify-content:flex-start}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .crest.cal{width:17px;height:17px}
  .dia .ev-partido b{font-size:.5rem}
}


/* ============ CALENDARIO LIGUERO ============ */
.liga-filtros{display:flex;gap:7px}
.liga-f{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);color:var(--texto-2);
  font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:.74rem;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s}
.liga-f:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--lila)}
.liga-f.on{background:var(--morado);border-color:var(--trigo);color:#fff}
.liga-lista{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.liga-p{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;
  background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:11px;padding:12px 14px;
  transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s}
.liga-p:hover{border-color:var(--lila);transform:translateX(3px)}
.liga-p.proximo{border-color:var(--trigo);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(232,201,122,.12),var(--superficie))}
.liga-p.jugado{opacity:.72}
.liga-jor{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--lila);text-align:center;line-height:1}
.liga-jor small{display:block;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.52rem;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--texto-2)}
.liga-rival{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}
.liga-rival .crest{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:1.6rem;flex-shrink:0}
.liga-rival .nom{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.92rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.liga-rival .sede{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:2px 6px;
  border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--borde);color:var(--texto-2);flex-shrink:0}
.liga-rival .sede.casa{border-color:var(--trigo);color:var(--trigo)}
.liga-fecha{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.78rem;color:var(--texto-2);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.liga-res{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.1rem;text-align:right}
.liga-res.v{color:#6BD6A3} .liga-res.e{color:var(--trigo)} .liga-res.d{color:#F09A9A}
@media (max-width:900px){.liga-lista{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .liga-filtros{gap:5px}
  .liga-f{padding:8px 12px;font-size:.68rem}
  .liga-p{grid-template-columns:38px 1fr auto;gap:9px;padding:10px}
  .liga-rival .nom{font-size:.84rem}
  .liga-fecha{font-size:.7rem}
}

/* ============ CARRUSEL SOCIAL ============ */
.fuentes{display:flex;gap:12px}
.fuentes a{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--texto-2);transition:all .25s}
.fuentes a:hover{background:var(--morado);color:#fff;border-color:var(--trigo)}
.carrusel-wrap{position:relative}
.carrusel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.pista-marco{overflow:hidden;flex:1}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .carrusel .flecha{display:none}
  .pista-marco{overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
    scrollbar-width:none;margin:0 -18px;padding:0 18px}
  .pista-marco::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .pista{transform:none!important;gap:12px}
  .slide{scroll-snap-align:center}
}
.pista{display:flex;gap:20px;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.slide{flex:0 0 calc(33.333% - 14px);background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:340px;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.slide:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--lila)}
.slide-img{height:190px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--morado-osc),var(--superficie-2))}
.slide-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s}
.slide:hover .slide-img img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.slide-img .noimg{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.red-badge{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;background:rgba(10,4,16,.8);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:.72rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.red-badge.ig{border-color:#E1306C;color:#FF8FB1}
.red-badge.x{border-color:#fff;color:#fff}
.red-badge.fb{border-color:#1877F2;color:#7FB3F7}
.slide-body{padding:18px 20px 22px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.slide-body time{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--texto-2);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.slide-body p{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.45;flex:1}
.slide-body .ver{margin-top:14px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lila)}
.slide:hover .ver{color:var(--trigo)}
.flecha{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);color:#fff;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;transition:all .25s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.flecha:hover{background:var(--morado);border-color:var(--trigo)}
.puntos{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:9px;margin-top:22px}
.punto{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;transition:all .3s}
.punto.on{background:var(--trigo);width:26px;border-radius:5px}
.barra-auto{height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:2px;margin-top:16px;overflow:hidden}
.barra-auto i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--trigo);width:0}



/* ============ RESULTADO + CLASIFICACIÓN ============ */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch}
.panel{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;padding:26px}
.panel h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:18px;color:var(--lila)}
.resultado{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-align:center;padding:18px 0}
.resultado .marcador{font-family:var(--display);font-size:3.4rem;color:var(--trigo)}
.resultado .n{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.85rem;margin-top:8px}
.resultado-meta{text-align:center;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--texto-2);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:var(--condensada)}
table.clasif{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.9rem}
table.clasif th{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--texto-2);text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--borde)}
table.clasif td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
table.clasif td.num{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600}
table.clasif tr.upp{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(123,47,190,.35),rgba(123,47,190,.08));border-left:3px solid var(--trigo)}
table.clasif tr.upp td{font-weight:700}

.clasif-scroll{max-height:470px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--morado) #E4DEEC;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;position:relative;border-radius:10px}
.clasif-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px}
.clasif-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--morado);border-radius:4px}
.clasif-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#E4DEEC;border-radius:4px}
table.clasif{min-width:560px}
/* Posición y equipo quedan fijos al desplazar en horizontal */
table.clasif th:nth-child(1),table.clasif td:nth-child(1){position:sticky;left:0;z-index:3;width:38px;min-width:38px}
table.clasif th:nth-child(2),table.clasif td:nth-child(2){position:sticky;left:38px;z-index:3;min-width:160px}
table.clasif th:nth-child(1),table.clasif th:nth-child(2){z-index:5}
table.clasif td:nth-child(1),table.clasif td:nth-child(2){background:#F4F1F7}
table.clasif tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:nth-child(1),
table.clasif tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:nth-child(2){background:#EFEAF5}
table.clasif td:nth-child(2){box-shadow:2px 0 6px -3px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.aviso-scroll{display:none;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B5B8A;text-align:right;margin-bottom:6px}


/* ============ CLASIFICACIÓN (panel claro) ============ */
.panel-clasif{background:#F4F1F7;border-color:#D9D2E2;color:#2A1B3D}
.panel-clasif h3{color:var(--morado-osc)}
.panel-clasif .clasif-scroll{scrollbar-color:var(--morado) #E4DEEC}
.panel-clasif .clasif-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#E4DEEC}
table.clasif th{color:#5C4B78;border-bottom:2px solid #CFC4DE;background:#F4F1F7;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2}
table.clasif td{border-bottom:1px solid #E4DEEC;color:#2A1B3D}
table.clasif tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(123,47,190,.035)}
table.clasif tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(123,47,190,.09)}
table.clasif td.pos{color:#6B5B8A}
table.clasif td.pts{font-weight:700;color:var(--morado-osc);font-size:1rem}
table.clasif td.g{color:#1F7A4D;font-weight:600}
table.clasif td.e{color:#8A7B4A}
table.clasif td.p{color:#B03A3A}
table.clasif td.dg{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600}
table.clasif td.dg.pos-dg{color:#1F7A4D}
table.clasif td.dg.neg-dg{color:#B03A3A}
.eq-nombre{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
/* Fila del club */
table.clasif tr.upp{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(123,47,190,.22),rgba(123,47,190,.06))!important;
  border-left:4px solid var(--morado)}
table.clasif tr.upp td{font-weight:700;color:var(--morado-osc)}
table.clasif tr.upp td:nth-child(1),table.clasif tr.upp td:nth-child(2){background:#E3D2F2}
table.clasif tr.upp td.pts{color:var(--morado)}
table.clasif tr.upp:hover{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(123,47,190,.3),rgba(123,47,190,.1))!important}
/* Zonas de ascenso y descenso */
.leyenda-clasif{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;font-size:.72rem;color:#5C4B78;
  font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.leyenda-clasif span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.leyenda-clasif i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block}
.zona-camp{background:var(--trigo-osc)}
.zona-promo{background:#4A8FBF}
.nota-clasif{font-size:.72rem;color:#6B5B8A;margin-top:8px;font-style:italic}
table.clasif tr.campeon td:nth-child(1){box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--trigo-osc)}
table.clasif tr.promo td:nth-child(1){box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 #4A8FBF}
table.clasif tr.campeon td:nth-child(1),table.clasif tr.campeon td:nth-child(2){background:#FBF3DC}
table.clasif tr.promo td:nth-child(1),table.clasif tr.promo td:nth-child(2){background:#E8F1F8}
table.clasif tr.campeon.upp td:nth-child(1),table.clasif tr.campeon.upp td:nth-child(2),
table.clasif tr.promo.upp td:nth-child(1),table.clasif tr.promo.upp td:nth-child(2){background:#E3D2F2}
.trofeo{color:var(--trigo-osc);font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1}
table.clasif tr.campeon td.pts{color:#8A6D1F}

/* ============ PLANTILLA ============ */
.jug-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:20px}
.jug{background:linear-gradient(170deg,var(--superficie-2),var(--superficie));border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.jug:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.jug .dorsal{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;z-index:3;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.6rem;
  line-height:1;color:#fff;background:var(--morado);border:2px solid var(--trigo);border-radius:9px;
  min-width:44px;height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 8px;
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.jug:not(:has(.jug-foto)) .dorsal{background:rgba(123,47,190,.55);border-color:rgba(232,201,122,.5)}
.jug .silueta{height:210px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;position:relative;
  background:#FFFFFF}
.jug:not(:has(.jug-foto)) .silueta{background:linear-gradient(165deg,#3A2153,#1F1230)}
.jug-foto{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;transition:transform .45s}
.jug:hover .jug-foto{transform:scale(1.05)}
.jug .silueta::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;height:2px;
  background:var(--morado);pointer-events:none}

.jug .silueta svg{width:110px;height:150px;opacity:.9}
.jug .info{padding:16px 18px 20px;position:relative}
.jug .pos{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--trigo)}
.jug .nombre{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:1.15rem;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px}
.jug .stats{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-top:10px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.jug .stats b{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;font-family:var(--condensada)}


.pos-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:24px}
.pos-tab{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);color:var(--texto-2);font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:.8rem;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s}
.pos-tab:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--lila)}
.pos-tab.on{background:var(--morado);border-color:var(--trigo);color:#fff}
.badge-j{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:4px;z-index:2}
.badge-j.fichaje{background:rgba(42,161,103,.25);border:1px solid #2AA167;color:#6BD6A3}
.badge-j.lesion{background:rgba(200,60,60,.22);border:1px solid #C24444;color:#F09A9A}



/* ============ CLASIFICACIÓN HISTÓRICA ============ */
.hp-tabla{margin-top:24px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--borde)}
.hp-tabla h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;
  font-size:.8rem;color:var(--lila);margin-bottom:14px}
.hp-tabla-scroll{max-height:330px;overflow:auto;border-radius:10px;background:#F4F1F7;
  scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--morado) #E4DEEC}
.hp-tabla-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{width:7px;height:7px}
.hp-tabla-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--morado);border-radius:4px}
table.clasif-hist{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;min-width:430px;color:#2A1B3D}
table.clasif-hist th{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;
  font-size:.62rem;color:#5C4B78;text-align:left;padding:8px 6px;background:#F4F1F7;
  position:sticky;top:0;border-bottom:2px solid #CFC4DE;z-index:2}
table.clasif-hist td{padding:7px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid #E4DEEC}
table.clasif-hist tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:rgba(123,47,190,.035)}
table.clasif-hist td.p{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;color:#6B5B8A;width:30px}
table.clasif-hist td.pts{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:700;color:var(--morado-osc)}
table.clasif-hist tr.propio{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(123,47,190,.22),rgba(123,47,190,.05))!important}
table.clasif-hist tr.propio td{font-weight:700;color:var(--morado-osc)}
table.clasif-hist .crest.xs{width:20px;height:20px}
@media (max-width:760px){.hp-tabla-scroll{max-height:290px}table.clasif-hist{font-size:.74rem}}

/* ============ TÉCNICO, EXJUGADORES Y CLUBES ============ */
.jug-nota{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--trigo);margin-top:5px;font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.04em}
#tecnico-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr))}
.clubes-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.club-card{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);
  border-radius:14px;padding:22px;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.club-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--trigo)}
.club-escudo{width:88px;height:88px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:12px;padding:8px}
.club-escudo img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.club-rel{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--trigo)}
.club-info h3{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:1.1rem;text-transform:uppercase;margin:4px 0 8px}
.club-info p{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--texto-2);line-height:1.5}
@media (max-width:900px){.clubes-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .club-card{padding:16px;gap:14px}
  .club-escudo{width:66px;height:66px}
  .club-info p{font-size:.78rem}
  #tecnico-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}

/* ============ EL CLUB ============ */
.club{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--fondo-2),var(--fondo));position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.club .espiga{position:absolute;left:-40px;bottom:-60px;font-size:22rem;opacity:.05;transform:rotate(-12deg);user-select:none}
.club-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.club-grid h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem);margin:12px 0 18px}
.club-grid p{color:var(--texto-2);margin-bottom:14px}
.club-grid p a{color:var(--trigo);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,201,122,.45)}
.club-grid p a:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--trigo)}
.valores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.valor{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:12px;padding:20px}
.valor .ic{font-size:1.5rem}
.valor h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:8px 0 6px;font-size:.95rem}
.valor p{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin:0}

/* ============ BANNER SOCIO ============ */
.socio-banner{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--morado-osc),var(--morado));border-radius:18px;padding:52px 48px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transform:skewY(0)}
.socio-banner::after{content:"UPP";position:absolute;right:-10px;bottom:-58px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:13rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);line-height:1}
.socio-banner h2{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3.6vw,2.4rem);max-width:20ch}
.socio-banner p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);margin-top:8px;max-width:46ch}
.socio-banner .btn-borde{border-color:#fff}
.socio-banner .btn-borde:hover{border-color:var(--trigo)}




/* ============ SOCIO DE NÚMERO ============ */
.socio-numero{margin-top:20px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(123,47,190,.28),rgba(36,21,52,.9));
  border:1px solid var(--borde);border-left:4px solid var(--trigo);border-radius:16px;padding:26px 28px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start}
.sn-txt h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.5rem;margin:8px 0 12px;color:#fff}
.sn-txt p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--texto-2);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:8px}
.sn-txt b{color:var(--trigo)}
.sn-sub{font-style:italic;font-size:.84rem!important;color:var(--lila)!important}
.socio-numero .btn{align-self:stretch;text-align:center}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .socio-numero{padding:20px 18px;margin-top:16px}
  .sn-txt h3{font-size:1.25rem}
  .sn-txt p{font-size:.85rem}
}

/* ============ HISTÓRICO ============ */
.hist-resumen{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-bottom:32px}
.hr-box{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--superficie-2),var(--superficie));border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;text-align:center}
.hr-num{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.6rem;color:var(--trigo);line-height:1}
.hr-lab{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:6px}
.hist-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:22px}
.hist-tab{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);color:var(--texto-2);font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:.85rem;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .25s}
.hist-tab:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--lila)}
.hist-tab.on{background:var(--morado);border-color:var(--trigo);color:#fff}
.hist-panel{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:16px;padding:28px}
.hp-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--borde)}
.hp-head h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.6rem}
.hp-cat{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lila);margin-top:4px}
.hp-pos{text-align:right}
.hp-pos .p{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.8rem;color:var(--trigo);line-height:1}
.hp-pos .l{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2)}
.hp-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(78px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px}
.st{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 8px;text-align:center}
.st b{display:block;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:1.35rem;color:#fff}
.st span{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2)}
.hp-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:26px}
.hp-cols h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--lila);margin-bottom:12px}
.gol-lista{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px}
.gol-lista li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:8px;font-size:.88rem}
.gol-lista li:first-child{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(123,47,190,.4),rgba(123,47,190,.1));border-left:3px solid var(--trigo)}
.gol-lista b{font-family:var(--condensada);color:var(--trigo);font-size:1.05rem}

.gol-lista li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.gol-foto{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 6%;
  flex-shrink:0;background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.gol-foto.sin{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.24);font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.gol-nombre{flex:1;line-height:1.25}
.gol-lista li:first-child .gol-foto{border-color:var(--trigo)}
@media (max-width:760px){.gol-foto{width:33px;height:33px;border-radius:8px}}
.hitos{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.hitos li{padding-left:20px;position:relative;line-height:1.45}
.hitos li::before{content:"▸";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--trigo)}
.resultado-goles{text-align:center;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin:-6px 0 14px}
.colapsable summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.9rem}
.colapsable summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.colapsable summary::after{content:"▾";color:var(--trigo);transition:transform .3s}
.colapsable[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.colapsable summary h3{margin:0}
.colapsable > ul, .colapsable > .liga-lista{margin-top:14px}
.liga-colapsable{margin-top:8px}
.liga-colapsable summary{justify-content:center;padding:14px;border:1px dashed var(--borde);border-radius:12px;color:var(--texto-2)}
.liga-colapsable summary:hover{border-color:var(--trigo);color:var(--texto)}
.liga-colapsable[open] summary{border-style:solid;color:var(--texto)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--trigo);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.panel-ultimo{margin-bottom:22px;padding:18px}
.panel-ultimo .resultado{transform:scale(.97)}
.panel-ultimo .resultado-goles{margin-bottom:0}
.ag-res{color:var(--trigo);margin-left:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.agenda li.jugado .c{color:var(--texto-2)}
.elvi-head{margin-top:44px}
.elvi-head h3{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:1.2rem}
.muro-embeds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-bottom:26px}
.embed-col{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.embed-cab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--borde)}
.embed-cab b{flex:1;font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.04em}
.embed-cab a{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--trigo);text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.embed-marco{flex:1;min-height:480px;background:#fff}
.embed-marco iframe{width:100%;height:480px;display:block;border:none}
.embed-x{background:transparent;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;padding:24px;text-align:center}
.embed-x p{color:var(--texto-2);font-size:.85rem;max-width:260px}
@media (max-width:760px){ .muro-embeds{grid-template-columns:1fr} .embed-marco,.embed-marco iframe{min-height:420px;height:420px} }
.hp-fase{margin-top:6px}
.hp-fase + .hp-tabla{margin-top:26px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px dashed var(--borde)}
.hp-fase .fase-pos{color:var(--trigo)}
.fase-resumen{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin:8px 0 14px;line-height:1.6}
.fase-resumen b{color:var(--trigo)}
.hp-plantilla{margin-top:26px;border-top:1px dashed var(--borde);padding-top:16px}
.hp-plantilla summary{cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--texto);list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.hp-plantilla summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.hp-plantilla summary::after{content:"▾";color:var(--trigo);transition:transform .3s}
.hp-plantilla[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.hp-plantilla .hp-tabla-scroll{margin-top:14px}
.stats-plantilla td.eq-nombre{text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}
.stats-plantilla .enc{color:var(--texto-2);font-weight:600;font-size:.78rem}
.tag-portero{font-size:.75rem}
.hp-nota{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:10px}
.records-club{margin-top:34px}
.records-club h3{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;
  font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:16px}
.records-club h3 span{color:var(--trigo);font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.14em;margin-left:8px}
.records-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:18px}
.record-card{background:var(--panel,rgba(255,255,255,.03));border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px}
.record-card h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;
  font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--texto)}
.record-card ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.record-card li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:.85rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.record-card li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.record-card li b{color:var(--texto);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.record-card li.lider .rc-nombre{color:var(--trigo);font-weight:700}
.record-card li.lider b{color:var(--trigo)}
.rc-lider{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-bottom:12px}
.rc-lider-nombre{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--trigo)}
.rc-lider-valor{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--texto);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.1}
.rc-detalle summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;
  color:var(--texto-2);list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.rc-detalle summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.rc-detalle summary::after{content:"▾";color:var(--trigo);transition:transform .3s}
.rc-detalle[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.rc-detalle ol{margin-top:10px;max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:6px}
.rc-pos{color:var(--texto-2);font-size:.72rem;min-width:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.record-card li{gap:8px}
.record-card li .rc-nombre{flex:1;text-align:left}
.hp-tec{margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--borde);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.hp-tec b{color:#fff}



/* ============ ¿TE ACUERDAS DE? ============ */
.vid-carrusel{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.vid-marco{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;flex:1;scrollbar-width:thin;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-color:var(--morado) transparent;
  scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.vid-card,.out-card{scroll-snap-align:start}
.vid-marco::-webkit-scrollbar{height:6px}
.vid-marco::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--morado);border-radius:3px}
.vid-pista{display:flex;gap:18px;padding-bottom:10px}
.vid-card{flex:0 0 280px;background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s;display:block}
.vid-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--trigo)}
.vid-thumb{position:relative;height:158px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--morado-osc),var(--superficie-2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.vid-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s}
.vid-card:hover .vid-thumb img{transform:scale(1.07)}
.vid-play{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.vid-play span{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(232,201,122,.92);color:#1A0E26;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;padding-left:4px;transition:transform .3s;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.vid-card:hover .vid-play span{transform:scale(1.14)}
.vid-vacio{font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.4rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.vid-body{padding:15px 17px 19px}
.vid-body h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:6px}
.vid-body time{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--trigo)}
.vid-body p{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:7px;line-height:1.4}
.vid-pendiente{opacity:.62;border-style:dashed}

/* ============ TIENDA ============ */
.tienda-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(215px,1fr));gap:20px}
.prod{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.prod:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:var(--trigo)}
.prod-img{height:210px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative}
.prod-img svg{width:150px;height:170px}
.prod .etq{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid var(--borde)}
.prod .etq.esp{background:var(--trigo);color:#231404;border-color:var(--trigo)}
.prod-body{padding:16px 18px 20px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.prod-body h3{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em}
.prod-body p{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:7px;flex:1;line-height:1.4}
.prod-pie{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:14px}
.prod-pie .precio{font-family:var(--display);color:var(--trigo);font-size:1.3rem}
.tienda-nota{text-align:center;margin-top:26px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--texto-2);max-width:60ch;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}




/* ============ AVISO Y RESERVA DE TIENDA ============ */
.aviso-tienda{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:28px;align-items:center;
  background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--superficie-2),var(--superficie));
  border:1px solid var(--borde);border-left:4px solid var(--trigo);border-radius:16px;
  padding:28px 30px;margin-bottom:30px}
.at-txt h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--trigo);margin-bottom:10px}
.at-txt p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--texto-2);line-height:1.55;max-width:52ch}
.at-txt b{color:#fff}
.at-cd{text-align:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.24);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 18px}
.at-cd-lab{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lila)}
.at-cd-fecha{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.35rem;margin:4px 0 14px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.countdown.pedido-cd{border-top:none;padding-top:0;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.countdown.pedido-cd .cd-box{min-width:0;flex:1}
.countdown.pedido-cd .num{font-size:1.9rem}
.at-cd .btn{width:100%;padding:13px 18px}
.pedido-cerrado{font-family:var(--condensada);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--trigo);font-size:.9rem;padding:12px 0}
.ok-stock{color:#6BD6A3}
@media (max-width:980px){.aviso-tienda{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:24px 20px}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .at-txt h3{font-size:1.3rem}
  .at-cd-fecha{font-size:1.15rem}
  .countdown.pedido-cd .num{font-size:1.5rem}
}


.prod-btns{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-mini{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:6px;padding:7px 12px;color:var(--texto-2);
  transition:all .25s;white-space:nowrap;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.btn-mini.reservar:hover{border-color:var(--trigo);color:var(--trigo);background:rgba(232,201,122,.1)}
.btn-mini.paypal{border-color:#0070BA;color:#5AB0E8}
.btn-mini.paypal:hover{background:#0070BA;color:#fff;border-color:#0070BA}


.precios-prod{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-end;width:100%}
.prod-pie .precio{font-family:var(--display);line-height:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.prod-pie .precio span{font-size:.62em}
.prod-pie .precio small{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:3px;font-weight:500}
.prod-pie .precio.socio{font-size:1.55rem;color:var(--trigo)}
.prod-pie .precio.socio small{color:var(--trigo);opacity:.8}
.prod-pie .precio.normal{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .precios-prod{gap:10px}
  .prod-pie .precio.socio{font-size:1.3rem}
  .prod-pie .precio.normal{font-size:1rem}
}

/* ============ OUTLET ============ */
.precios-outlet{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.po{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--texto-2);background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px}
.po b{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;margin-left:5px}
.po.socio{border-color:var(--trigo);color:var(--trigo)}
.po.socio b{color:var(--trigo)}
.out-card{flex:0 0 240px;background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.out-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--trigo)}
.out-card.agotado{opacity:.5}
.out-card.agotado:hover{transform:none;border-color:var(--borde)}
.out-img{height:190px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),rgba(0,0,0,.28))}
.out-img svg{width:132px;height:150px}
.out-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.out-temp{position:absolute;top:11px;left:11px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;background:rgba(10,4,16,.72);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:5px;padding:3px 9px}
.stock-badge{position:absolute;top:11px;right:11px;font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;border-radius:5px;padding:3px 9px}
.stock-badge.ok{background:rgba(42,161,103,.22);border:1px solid #2AA167;color:#6BD6A3}
.stock-badge.poco{background:rgba(232,201,122,.18);border:1px solid var(--trigo);color:var(--trigo)}
.stock-badge.no{background:rgba(200,60,60,.18);border:1px solid #C24444;color:#F09A9A}
.out-body{padding:15px 17px 18px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.out-body h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.25}
.tallas{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:11px}
.talla{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.05em;border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:5px;padding:3px 8px;color:var(--texto-2)}
.talla.hay{border-color:var(--lila);color:#fff}
.talla.sin{opacity:.35;text-decoration:line-through}
.out-precio{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.out-precio .socio{font-family:var(--display);color:var(--trigo);font-size:1.25rem}
.out-precio .socio small{font-family:var(--condensada);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--texto-2);display:block;margin-top:-2px}
.out-precio .normal{font-family:var(--condensada);color:var(--texto-2);font-size:.95rem;text-align:right}
.out-precio .normal small{display:block;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em}
.outlet-nota{margin-top:18px;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--texto-2);text-align:center}

/* ============ PEDIDO TIENDA ============ */
.pedido{margin-top:34px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--superficie-2),var(--superficie));border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:18px;padding:34px;text-align:center}
.pedido h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:24px}
.pasos-pedido{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:22px;margin-bottom:26px;text-align:left}
.paso-p{position:relative;padding-left:52px}
.paso-p .np{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--morado);border:1px solid var(--trigo);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.1rem;color:#fff}
.paso-p h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.paso-p p{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--texto-2);line-height:1.5}
.paso-p a{color:var(--trigo);text-decoration:underline;word-break:break-all}

/* ============ CUOTAS SOCIOS ============ */
.cuotas{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:26px}
.cuota{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 20px;text-align:center;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.cuota:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--lila)}
.cuota .tipo{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--lila)}
.cuota .precio{font-family:var(--display);font-size:3rem;color:#fff;margin:10px 0 6px}
.cuota .precio span{font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--trigo)}
.cuota p{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.cuota.destacada{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--morado-osc),var(--superficie-2));border-color:var(--trigo)}
.cuota.destacada .precio{color:var(--trigo)}
.cuota.destacada .precio span{color:#fff}
.alta-info{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:34px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.alta-info b{color:var(--trigo)}

/* ============ PATROCINADORES ============ */
/* ============ PATROCINADORES ============ */
.spons-main{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:28px 56px;margin-bottom:34px;padding:10px 0}
.spons-main a{display:flex}
.spon-logo-solo{height:98px;max-width:300px;width:auto;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .3s}
.spons-main a:hover .spon-logo-solo{transform:scale(1.05)}
@media (max-width:760px){ .spons-main{gap:20px 34px} .spon-logo-solo{height:66px;max-width:200px} }
.spons-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:18px}
.spons-grid > a{display:block}
.spon{background:var(--superficie);border:1px solid var(--borde);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0}
.spons-grid > a:hover .spon,.spon:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--trigo)}
.spon-placa{background:#FFFFFF;height:118px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px}
.spon-placa img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .35s}
.spons-grid > a:hover .spon-placa img,.spon:hover .spon-placa img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.spon-txt{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.6rem;color:#B9AEC8}
.spon-pie{padding:13px 15px 15px;text-align:center}
.spon-pie b{display:block;font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.06em;font-size:.86rem;color:#fff}
.spon-pie span{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--texto-2);margin-top:3px}
.spon.vacante{border-style:dashed;background:transparent}
.spon.vacante .spon-placa{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.spon.vacante .spon-txt{color:var(--lila);font-size:2.2rem}
.spon.vacante:hover .spon-placa{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .spons-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  .spon-placa{height:92px;padding:12px}
  .spon-pie{padding:10px 10px 12px}
  .spon-pie b{font-size:.76rem}
  .spon-pie span{font-size:.66rem}
}

/* ============ FOOTER ============ */
footer{background:#0E0716;border-top:1px solid var(--borde);padding:56px 0 0;margin-top:72px}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:34px;padding-bottom:44px}
.foot-grid h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--lila);margin-bottom:14px}
.foot-grid ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:9px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.foot-grid ul a:hover{color:var(--trigo)}
.foot-claim{color:var(--texto-2);font-size:.88rem;margin-top:12px;max-width:32ch}
.foot-contacto{margin-top:16px}
.foot-contacto h4{font-family:var(--condensada);font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;
  font-size:.82rem;color:var(--lila);margin-bottom:12px}
.foot-contacto p{color:var(--texto-2);font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:9px;
  display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}
.foot-contacto a{color:var(--texto-2);word-break:break-word}
.foot-contacto a:hover{color:var(--trigo)}
.foot-contacto .ic-c{flex-shrink:0;opacity:.8}
.foot-contacto .cp{color:var(--texto-2);opacity:.85}

.legal{border-top:1px solid var(--borde);padding:18px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--texto-2)}
.legal .links{display:flex;gap:18px}
.legal a:hover{color:var(--trigo)}

/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */

/* ---- TABLET (≤980px) ---- */
@media (max-width:980px){
  .wrap{padding:0 18px}
  .section{padding:56px 0}
  .split,.club-grid,.cal-layout,.hp-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .slide{flex:0 0 calc(50% - 10px)}
  .socio-banner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;padding:38px 32px;gap:22px}
  .socio-banner::after{font-size:9rem;bottom:-40px}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}
  .agenda{order:-1}
}

/* ---- MÓVIL (≤760px) ---- */
@media (max-width:760px){
  :root{--nav-h:62px;--util-h:32px}
  /* --- Navegación --- */
  nav.menu{display:none}
  nav.menu.abierto{display:flex;position:fixed;top:calc(var(--nav-h) + var(--util-h));left:0;right:0;bottom:0;
    height:auto;background:#100818;flex-direction:column;
    padding:22px 22px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));gap:4px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:1200}
  nav.menu.abierto a{font-size:1.28rem;padding:16px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);letter-spacing:.06em}
  nav.menu.abierto a::after{display:none}
  .hamb{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;margin-right:-8px}
  body.menu-abierto{overflow:hidden}
  .nav .wrap{height:62px}
  .marca .nombre{font-size:.86rem}
  .marca .nombre small{font-size:.54rem;letter-spacing:.2em}
  .crest.sm{width:34px;height:34px}

  /* --- Barra utilitaria: scroll horizontal sin cortar --- */
  .utility{font-size:.72rem}
  .utility .wrap{height:32px;gap:12px}
  .utility .redes{gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;white-space:nowrap}
  .utility .redes::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .utility .socio{white-space:nowrap;font-size:.68rem}

  /* --- Hero --- */
  .hero{min-height:auto;padding:54px 0 40px}
  .hero .wrap{padding-top:20px;padding-bottom:30px}
  .hero .dorsal{font-size:16rem;right:-8%;opacity:.55}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,11vw,3.4rem);max-width:100%}
  .hero p{font-size:.96rem;margin-bottom:24px}
  .hero .ctas{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:10px}
  .hero .ctas .btn{text-align:center;padding:16px 20px}
  .hero .fund{position:static;display:block;margin-top:26px;padding:0 18px;font-size:.64rem}

  /* --- Próximo partido: compacto en 2 columnas --- */
  .match-band{margin-top:0;padding-top:8px}
  .match-card{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;padding:20px 16px;gap:14px;border-radius:14px}
  .match-meta{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.12em;line-height:1.4}
  .vs{grid-column:1/-1;order:3;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
  .vs .fecha{font-size:.98rem}
  .vs .campo{font-size:.74rem}
  .equipo{gap:7px}
  .equipo .n{font-size:.76rem;line-height:1.2}
  .crest{width:62px;height:62px}
  .countdown{order:4;gap:6px;padding-top:14px}
  .cd-box{min-width:0;flex:1}
  .cd-box .num{font-size:1.7rem}
  .cd-box .lab{font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.14em;margin-top:3px}

  /* --- Secciones y titulares --- */
  .section{padding:44px 0}
  .section-head{margin-bottom:24px;gap:10px}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.55rem,7vw,2rem)}
  .eyebrow{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.18em}
  .auto-nota{font-size:.68rem}

  /* --- Calendario: sin recorte, celdas legibles --- */
  .calendario{padding:12px 10px;border-radius:14px}
  .cal-dow{gap:4px}
  .cal-dow span{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.06em;padding-bottom:6px}
  .cal-grid{gap:4px}
  .dia{min-height:52px;padding:4px 3px;gap:2px;border-radius:6px}
  .dia .n{font-size:.72rem}
  .dia .ev{font-size:.48rem;gap:2px;letter-spacing:0}
  .dia .ev b{font-weight:600}
  .dia.hoy::after{font-size:.44rem;padding:0 3px;top:3px;right:3px}
  .leyenda{font-size:.68rem;gap:12px}

  /* --- Carrusel social --- */
  .slide{flex:0 0 100%;min-height:0}
  .slide-img{height:170px}
  .carrusel{gap:6px}
  .flecha{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:1.4rem}
  .punto{width:11px;height:11px}
  .punto.on{width:28px}
  .puntos{gap:8px;margin-top:18px;padding:8px 0}

  /* --- Clasificación: tabla compacta --- */
  .clasif-scroll{max-height:360px}
  table.clasif{font-size:.8rem}
  table.clasif th{font-size:.6rem;padding:7px 4px;letter-spacing:.06em}
  table.clasif td{padding:8px 4px}
  .eq-nombre{max-width:118px}
  table.clasif{min-width:520px}
  table.clasif th,table.clasif td{padding:8px 5px}
  .equipo-celda{gap:6px;font-size:.78rem}
  .crest.xs{width:21px;height:21px}
  .resultado .marcador{font-size:2.6rem}
  .panel{padding:20px 16px}

  /* --- Plantilla --- */
  .jug-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  .jug .silueta{height:158px}
  .jug .silueta svg{width:80px;height:110px}
  .jug .dorsal{font-size:1.25rem;min-width:36px;height:36px;top:8px;right:8px;border-radius:8px}
  .jug .info{padding:11px 12px 15px}
  .jug .nombre{font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.15}
  .jug .pos{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em}
  .badge-j{font-size:.52rem;padding:3px 6px;top:8px;left:8px;letter-spacing:.08em}
  .pos-tabs{gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap;scrollbar-width:none;padding-bottom:4px;
    -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 88%,transparent)}
  .pos-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .pos-tab{padding:11px 16px;font-size:.74rem;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}

  /* --- El club --- */
  .club .espiga{font-size:13rem;left:-30px;bottom:-30px}
  .valores{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
  .valor{padding:15px 13px}
  .valor h4{font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.05em}
  .valor p{font-size:.74rem}
  .valor .ic{font-size:1.25rem}

  /* --- Histórico --- */
  .hist-resumen{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px}
  .hr-box{padding:16px 12px}
  .hr-num{font-size:2rem}
  .hr-lab{font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em}
  .hist-tabs{gap:6px;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 88%,transparent)}
  .hist-tab{padding:10px 15px;font-size:.76rem}
  .hist-panel{padding:20px 16px;border-radius:14px}
  .hp-head h3{font-size:1.3rem}
  .hp-pos .p{font-size:2.1rem}
  .hp-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}
  .st{padding:9px 4px}
  .st b{font-size:1.05rem}
  .st span{font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .hp-cols{gap:22px}
  .gol-lista li{padding:8px 10px;font-size:.82rem}
  .hitos{font-size:.82rem}
  .vid-card{flex:0 0 218px}
  .vid-thumb{height:124px}

  /* --- Tienda --- */
  .tienda-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  .prod-img{height:158px}
  .prod-img svg{width:108px;height:124px}
  .prod-body{padding:12px 13px 16px}
  .prod-body h3{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.2}
  .prod-body p{font-size:.72rem}
  .prod-pie{margin-top:11px;gap:8px}
  .btn-mini{font-size:.64rem;padding:6px 9px}
  .prod .etq{font-size:.56rem;padding:3px 7px;top:9px;left:9px}
  .out-card{flex:0 0 190px}
  .out-img{height:150px}
  .out-img svg{width:100px;height:116px}
  .out-body h4{font-size:.85rem}
  .talla{font-size:.64rem;padding:2px 6px}
  .out-precio .socio{font-size:1.1rem}
  .precios-outlet{gap:7px}
  .po{font-size:.68rem;padding:7px 11px}

  /* --- Pedido --- */
  .pedido{padding:24px 18px;border-radius:14px}
  .pedido h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:18px}
  .pasos-pedido{gap:18px;margin-bottom:22px}
  .paso-p{padding-left:0;padding-top:46px}
  .paso-p .np{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:1rem}
  .paso-p h4{font-size:.86rem}

  /* --- Socios --- */
  .socio-banner{padding:30px 22px;border-radius:14px}
  .socio-banner h2{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,6.5vw,1.9rem)}
  .socio-banner p{font-size:.88rem}
  .socio-banner .btn{width:100%;text-align:center}
  .cuotas{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:20px}
  .cuota{padding:18px 12px}
  .cuota .precio{font-size:2.1rem}
  .cuota .tipo{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.08em}
  .cuota p{font-size:.7rem}
  .alta-info{gap:12px;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;font-size:.82rem;margin-top:20px}

  /* --- Patrocinadores y footer --- */
  .spons-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  .spon{min-height:74px;font-size:.68rem}
  footer{padding:40px 0 0;margin-top:48px}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;padding-bottom:32px}
  .foot-claim{max-width:100%}
  .legal{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;font-size:.7rem}
  .legal .links{gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}

  /* --- Áreas táctiles cómodas --- */
  .tab,.pos-tab,.hist-tab,.btn{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .fuentes a{width:40px;height:40px}
}

/* ---- MÓVIL PEQUEÑO (≤400px) ---- */
@media (max-width:400px){
  .wrap{padding:0 14px}
  .hero h1{font-size:2.1rem}
  .jug-grid,.tienda-grid,.cuotas,.valores{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hist-resumen{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .cd-box .num{font-size:1.45rem}
  .dia{min-height:46px}
  .dia .ev{font-size:.44rem}
  .match-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center}
  .equipo{flex-direction:row;justify-content:center;gap:12px}
  .crest{width:52px;height:52px}
  .hp-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
}

/* ===== AFINADO ESCRITORIO ===== */
@media (min-width:1100px){
  .hero .wrap{padding-top:84px;padding-bottom:84px}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(3.4rem,6.4vw,6rem);letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:.98}
  .hero p{font-size:1.14rem;max-width:56ch}
  .hero .btn{padding:15px 34px;font-size:1rem}
  .section-head{margin-bottom:42px}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.9rem)}
  .cal-grid .cal-dia{min-height:86px}
  .clasif td,.clasif th{padding:11px 14px}
  .clasif tbody tr{transition:background .2s}
  .clasif tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(232,201,122,.06)}
  .clasif-hist tbody tr:hover{background:rgba(232,201,122,.06)}
  .vid-card{flex-basis:305px}
  .vid-thumb{height:172px}
  .jug-grid{gap:24px}
  .prod:hover,.jug:hover{box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
  .panel{padding:26px}
  .panel-ultimo{padding:20px}
  footer .wrap{padding-top:8px}
}
@media (min-width:1500px){
  .hero{min-height:78vh}
  .muro-embeds{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}

<!-- ===== EL CLUB ===== -->
<section class="section club" id="club">
  <div class="espiga" aria-hidden="true">🌾</div>
  <div class="wrap club-grid">
    <div>
      <span class="eyebrow">Quiénes somos</span>
      <h2>Un club de sus socios,<br>por y para Palencia</h2>
      <p>Nacimos en 2018, impulsados por aficionados que se sentían huérfanos de un equipo al que seguir. Decidimos crear el nuestro: un club que gobiernan los socios que así lo desean, empoderándose y sin dejar la gestión de su club en manos de terceros.</p>
      <p>Vestimos de morado como la tierra castellana que defendemos, jugamos en el Sergio Asenjo y llevamos la bandera del fútbol popular por toda la provincia.</p>
      <p>Y no caminamos solos: formamos parte de la <b>red de clubes de fútbol popular</b> y de <a href="https://fasfe.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>FASFE</b></a>, la Federación de Accionistas y Socios del Fútbol Español, que vela por los intereses de las aficiones y los socios en los clubes de nuestro país. A través de FASFE pertenecemos a <a href="https://www.fanseurope.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>Football Supporters Europe</b></a> —la red europea de aficiones en la que se integró Supporters Direct Europe—, que nos conecta con los clubes propiedad de sus hinchas de todo el continente: con ella viajamos hasta Dinamarca para aprender del histórico BK Frem de Copenhague.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="valores">
      <div class="valor"><div class="ic">🗳️</div><h4>Propiedad social</h4><p>Un socio, un voto. El club es de quien lo siente.</p></div>
      <div class="valor"><div class="ic">🌾</div><h4>Carácter castellano</h4><p>Comprometidos con nuestra tierra y contra la despoblación.</p></div>
      <div class="valor"><div class="ic">🤝</div><h4>Comunidad</h4><p>Recogidas solidarias, igualdad y barrio: fútbol con causa.</p></div>
      <div class="valor"><div class="ic">🏛️</div><h4>De dónde venimos</h4><p>Somos los últimos socios que quedamos del extinto Club de Fútbol Palencia y del CD Palencia Balompié, sumados a quienes se nos han ido uniendo en este lustro largo de existencia.</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="socio-numero">
      <div class="sn-txt">
        <span class="eyebrow">Propiedad social</span>
        <h3>Hazte socio de número</h3>
        <p>Ser <b>socio de número</b> es dar un paso más: significa <b>poder decidir en la asamblea</b>, votar los puntos del orden del día y participar en el rumbo del club como un socio implicado más.</p>
        <p class="sn-sub">Aquí la gestión no se deja en manos de terceros: mandan los socios. Y cada voto cuenta lo mismo.</p>
      </div>
      <a class="btn btn-primario" href="mailto:oficina@unionpopularpalencia.com?subject=Solicitud%20para%20ser%20socio%20de%20n%C3%BAmero&body=Hola,%0A%0AQuiero%20solicitar%20ser%20socio%2Fa%20de%20n%C3%BAmero%20del%20CD%20Uni%C3%B3n%20Popular%20de%20Palencia%20y%20poder%20participar%20en%20la%20asamblea.%0A%0A-%20Nombre%20y%20apellidos%3A%0A-%20DNI%3A%0A-%20Tel%C3%A9fono%3A%0A-%20Correo%3A%0A-%20%C2%BFEres%20ya%20soci%40%3F%3A%0A%0AGracias.">✉ Quiero ser socio de número</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

function escudoHTML(nombre, clase='crest'){
  const src = ESCUDOS_RIVALES[nombre] || ESCUDOS_RIVALES[ALIAS_ESCUDOS[nombre]];
  if(src) return `<img class="${clase} crest-img" src="${src}" alt="Escudo ${nombre}" loading="lazy">`;
  const ini = nombre.split(' ').map(w=>w[0]).join('').replace(/[^A-ZÁÉÍÓÚ]/gi,'').slice(0,3).toUpperCase();
  return `<span class="${clase} crest-fallback" role="img" aria-label="Escudo ${nombre}">${ini}</span>`;
}

const CAMPO_LOCAL = 'Campo Sergio Asenjo';
const HORA_DEFECTO = '16:30';

// ===== PLANNING DEL MES (editable) =====
const MES = { anio:2026, mes:8, nombre:"Agosto 2026", subtitulo:"Pretemporada 26/27" };

// tipo: "entreno" | "partido"
const EVENTOS = [
